newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rawlings cut to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rawlings cut to sell.

text.p: -- Hilliard Lyons said Tuesday its consumer products analyst Wesley Roberts lowered his rating on Rawlings Sporting Goods Inc to a sell from a hold based on his lack of confidence in the company's ability to meet his long term growth forecasts.

-- Rawlings management recently said that earnings for its its fiscal first quarter ending November 30 will be well below analysts' estimates and that the company will report a loss. Roberts had been estimating a profit of $0.12 a share.

-- Rawlings had cited reduced shipments of baseball products and weakness in basketball sales as reasons for the shortfall. Roberts was expecting baseball shipments to suffer in the quarter, but the degree of the impact came as a surprise, Hilliard Lyons said in a report.
-- Based on these events and a long history of earnings disappointments, Roberts is no longer comfortable holding Rawlings' shares, the report said.
-- Shares of Rawlings closed at 8-1/4 yesterday.
